mina: Quick topic Private deploy connectivity defaults. We need a single GA default and an explicit upgrade path so customers can move to hardened network modes later. Options: shared SNAT relay (fast onboarding), customer-managed egress (static IPs), or dedicated peering (BGP). Goal: pick default for GA and list migration + rollback behavior.

raul: I'm leaning shared relay default. Most field asks are "make it work with minimal firewall changes". Relay minimizes lift. But add strict per-tenant rate limits and IP quotas to avoid abuse/cost runaway.

ops-rita: Relay works operationally. Two caveats: 1) IP pool capacity — we need an eviction/rotation plan, 2) audit trail when we fall back to relay from customer-egress so networking owners see why.

sales-jon: Customers in regulated sectors will push for egress ownership. We should design a self-serve opt-in where they submit egress IPs and we validate reachability and ownership (reverse DNS check or signed token).

qa-lee: Migration tests: zero-downtime flip, drain active connections, and rehydrate KV cache on new path. If error rate increases by >1% or tail latency 99th worsens by >50ms during migration, auto-revert. Put these thresholds in the rollout acceptance criteria.

mina: Proposal: GA default = relay; customer-egress = opt-in self-serve; peering = Dedicated only (sales-led). Fallback: agent probes egress targets; after 3 consecutive probe failures switch to relay and emit audit event. Admin override allowed in Console.

raul: API sketch for toggle: POST /v1/tenants/:id/connectivity { "mode":"relay|egress|peering", "egress_ips":["198.51.100.12"], "asn":"64520" } GET returns {"mode":"egress","health":"ok|degraded|down","last_probe":"2024-05-01T12:34:56Z"}. Need a dry-run validation endpoint too.

ops-rita: Packaging checklist: agent flags for mode selection, firewall port list (443, 80, 53), DNS considerations for internal resolver, healthcheck endpoints, and sample K8s manifest + CRD to flip modes. Also call out IPv6 behaviour and NAT64 requirements.

sales-jon: Add customer communication templates: migration window, pre-cutover checklist, test URL, rollback expectations.

buildbot: buildbot: New internal doc created: https://docs.redwood.ai/internal/private-connectivity-ga-draft :robot_face:

mina: Action items: Raul -> relay sizing + IP pool model; Ops-Rita -> CRD + smoke tests; QA-Lee -> migration test plan + thresholds; Sales-Jon -> CS templates. I'll update roadmap ticket and set 20m follow-up tomorrow.

(ended)
